name: v1.13.8
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix releasing by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3911
* Fix data race on shared PRNG in FunASR-Nano and Qwen3-ASR offline recognizers by @fra-shipper in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3912
* Support building within a termux terminal on Android devices by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3916
* Support sherpa-onnx with Python in Termux on Android by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3922
* Fix Go API tests in CI for Windows by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3932
* Add Kokoro v1.0 em_santa voice by @kroryan in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3928
* Add Nabra-82M Arabic TTS conversion scripts for Kokoro runtime by @marwanelamami in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3898
* Fix Cohere Transcribe hallucinating sentences on silent audio by @kyo-zzz in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3924
* Fix Moonshine v2 hallucinating text on silent audio by @kyo-zzz in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3923
* Fix FunASR-Nano hallucinating text on silent audio by @kyo-zzz in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3921
* Fix Canary empty transcript when the first decoded token is eos by @kyo-zzz in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3920
* Add Intel NPU support through OpenVINO by @jacob-vincent-mink in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3910
* Add per-segment confidence computation for OfflineSpeakerDiarization by @matiaslin in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3881
* Upload the nabra 82M Arabic TTS int8 model by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3933
* Add Go API for Windows arm64 by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3934
* Add Go bindings for OfflineSpeakerDiarization confidence computation by @matiaslin in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3936
* fix(nemo/qnn/parakeet-ctc): wrapper.py raises NameError on undefined `feat_dim` by @Anai-Guo in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3937
* Fix CI tests by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3940
* Update onnxruntime to v1.28.2 by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3935
* Add robust download retry logic to all test scripts by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3941
* Support running Rust API examples on termux within Android by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3942
* Add confidence computation support for speaker diarization to JNI. by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3943
* fix(python-tests): UnboundLocalError instead of the intended ValueError in test_fast_clustering by @Anai-Guo in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3944
* Test using uv to install sherpa-onnx by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3946
* Release v1.13.8 by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3945

## New Contributors
* @kroryan made their first contribution in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3928
* @marwanelamami made their first contribution in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3898
* @kyo-zzz made their first contribution in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3924
* @jacob-vincent-mink made their first contribution in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3910
* @Anai-Guo made their first contribution in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/3937

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/compare/v1.13.7...v1.13.8
